'''ZT-001D''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]], it was protecting the [[GEMINI Prime]] in the [[Darvannis factory|factory]] on [[Darvannis]]. During the [[raid on Darvannis]] it attacked [[Torian Cadera]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] when they tried to reach GEMINI and was destroyed during the fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZT-001D appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 14: Mandalore the Avenger'''.
